text: bestmatch: Best Match Flag. A flag stating whether the row represents the best match between the critical care and episode start and end dates for this critical care period. This flag is used to limit the data in instances where there is more than one row per critical care period. See Appendix C in the Critical Care 2008-09 publication for further details.

name: bressupdays
text: bressupdays: Basic Respiratory Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received basic respiratory support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: ccadmisorc
text: ccadmisorc: Critical Care Admission Source. The source of admission to this crtical care period - adult critical care only. Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_admission_source.html

name: ccadmitype
text: ccadmitype: Critical Care Admission Type. The circumstances leading to admission to this crtical care period - adult critical care only. Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_admission_type.html

name: ccapcrel
text: ccapcrel: Critical Care APC Relationship. A comparison of the dates of the critical care period and those of the associated admitted patient care episode. This is used in the derivation of the best match flag by producing a hierarchy of relationships. See CCAPREL in https://nhs-prod.global.ssl.fastly.net/binaries/content/assets/website-assets/data-and-information/data-tools-and-services/data-services/hospital-episode-statistics/hes-data-dictionary/acc_data_dictionary_amended2021v2.pdf

name: ccdisdate
text: ccdisdate: Critical Care Discharge Date. Date of discharge from this critical care period. https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_discharge_date.html

name: ccdisdest
text: ccdisdest: Critical Care Discharge Destination. The primary organisation type that the patient has been discharged to at the end of the critical care period.  Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_discharge_destination.html

name: ccdisloc
text: ccdisloc: Critical Care Discharge Location. The principal location that the patient is discharged to at the end of the critical care period. Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_discharge_location.html

name: ccdisrdydate
text: ccdisrdydate: Critical Care Discharge Ready Date. The date the patient has been declared clinically ready for discharge or transfer from the critical care period.

name: ccdisrdytime
text: ccdisrdytime: Critical Care Discharge Ready Time. The time the patient has been declared clinically ready for discharge or transfer from the critical care period.

name: ccdisstat
text: ccdisstat: Critical Care Discharge Status. The discharge status of a patient who is discharged from a ward stay where they were receiving care as part of a critical care period and the discharge ends the critical care period.  Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_discharge_status.html

name: ccdistime
text: ccdistime: Critical Care Discharge Time. Time of discharge from this critical care period.  https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_discharge_time.html

name: cclev2days
text: cclev2days: Critical Care Level 2 Days. The total number of days that the patient received level 2 support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: cclev3days
text: cclev3days: Critical Care Level 3 Days. The total number of days that the patient received level 3 support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: ccsorcloc
text: ccsorcloc: Critical Care Source Location. The type of location the patient was in prior to the start of the critical care period.  Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_source_location.html

name: ccstartdate
text: ccstartdate: Critical Care Start Date. Start date of this critical care period. https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_start_date.html

name: ccstarttime
text: ccstarttime: Critical Care Start Time. Start time of this critical care period. https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_start_time.html

name: ccunitfun
text: ccunitfun: Critical Care Unit Function. The type of area to which the patient was admitted during a critical care period. Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/attributes/critical_care_unit_function.html

name: cds_message_version_number
text: cds_message_version_number: CDS Message Version Number. This item represents the CDS Schema Version used to submit the interchange the data was carried in.

name: dermsupdays
text: dermsupdays: Dermatological Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received dermatological support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: disdate
text: disdate: Date of Discharge (Hospital Provider Spell). The date a patient was discharged from a Hospital Provider Spell.

name: epiend
text: epiend: Episode End Date. A date that identifies when an episode within a hospital provider spell ended, i.e. the date on which the patient was discharged or, if staying in hospital, the date the consultant responsible for care changed.

name: epistart
text: epistart: Episode Start Date. A date that identifies when an episode within a hospital provider spell started, i.e. the date on which the patient was admitted or, if in hospital, the date the consultant responsible for care changed.

name: epistat
text: epistat: Episode Status. Episode Status for Critical Care HES Status of episode 1 if episode.end_date() is null 3 if episode.end_date() is not null (Finished)

name: epitype
text:
epitype: Episode Type. Report field Episode Type for Critical Care adds "6" to the front of the hes epi_type for the carrying episode:

61 = General episode (anything that is not covered by the other codes)

62 = Delivery episode

63 = Birth episode

64 = Formally detained under the provisions of mental health legislation or long-term

(over one year) psychiatric patients who should have additional information

recorded on the psychiatric census. This value can only appear in unfinished

records (Episode Status (EPISTAT) = 1)

65 = Other delivery event

66 = Other birth event

name: gisupdays
text: gisupdays: Gastro-Intestinal Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received gastro-intestinal system support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: liversupdays
text: liversupdays: Liver Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received liver support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: neurosupdays
text: neurosupdays: Neurological Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received neurological support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: orgsupmax
text: orgsupmax: Organ Support Maximum. The maximum number of ORGAN SYSTEMS SUPPORTED on any one day during a CRITICAL CARE PERIOD. Each organ system can only be counted once on any calendar day. Both basic and advanced categories cannot be counted at the same time. The number of organ systems supported can be between 0 to 7, although for the purposes of recording on the Commissioning Data Set messages Gastro-intestinal support days are not recorded so the maximum is effectively 6.

name: procode3
text: procode3: Provider Code (Provider Organisation). Derives the first 3 characters of a provider code

name: rensupdays
text: rensupdays: Renal Support Days. The total number of days that the patient received renal support during an adult critical care period ranging from 0 to 997 days.

name: susrecid
text: susrecid: SUS Record ID. The Secondary Uses Service (SUS) generated unique identifier for the episode this critical care period was specified on.

name: unitbedconfig
text: unitbedconfig: Critical Care Unit Bed Configuration. The main composition of critical care bed types for the ward.  Code values here: https://www.datadictionary.nhs.uk/data_elements/critical_care_unit_bed_configuration.html

name: spellno
text:
spellno: Hospital Provider Spell Number. A unique identifier for each Hospital Provider Spell for a Health Care Provider. This field is unavailable for use, and is null in all years.



This field is not made available in HES or lowlat due to the risk of restricted or identifiable data being populated in the field.

name: PERSON_ID_DEID
text: PERSON_ID_DEID: Person ID De-identified. This field contains a pseudonymised unique identifier for each individual patient.

name: ACCESSIBLE_INFORMATION_PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED
text: ACCESSIBLE_INFORMATION_PROFESSIONAL_REQUIRED: Accessible Information Professional Required. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to identify that the Patient requires support from a communication professional.

name: ACCOMMODATION_STATUS
text: ACCOMMODATION_STATUS: Accommodation Status. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to identify the details of the ACCOMMODATION of the PERSON.

name: ACUITY
text:
ACUITY: Acuity. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to indicate the acuity of the Patient's condition on the Emergency Care Initial Assessment Date and Emergency Care Initial Assessment Time.



This may be determined by a formal triage process, or by the physical allocation of the Patient to a

specific clinical area such as Resuscitation.

name: AGE_AT_CDS_ACTIVITY_DATE
text: AGE_AT_CDS_ACTIVITY_DATE: Age At Cds Activity Date. The age in years of the patient derived by the sender as at the relevant CDS activity date of the CDS type.

name: ARRIVAL_DATE
text: ARRIVAL_DATE: Arrival Date. The date on which the patient arrived in Accident and Emergency.

name: ARRIVAL_MODE
text: ARRIVAL_MODE: Arrival Mode. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to identify the transport mode by which the Patient arrived at the Emergency Care Department.

name: ARRIVAL_TIME
text: ARRIVAL_TIME: Arrival Time. The time (HH:MM:SS) at which the patient arrived in A&E.

name: ASSESSMENT_DATE
text: ASSESSMENT_DATE: Assessment Date. This records the date when the Patient is first assessed in the Accident and Emergency Department.

name: ASSESSMENT_TIME
text: ASSESSMENT_TIME: Assessment Time. The time (HH:MM:SS) at which the A&E Initial Assessment was made.

name: ATTENDANCE_CATEGORY
text: ATTENDANCE_CATEGORY: Attendance Category. The category of Emergency Care Attendance.

name: ATTENDANCE_SOURCE
text: ATTENDANCE_SOURCE: Attendance Source. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to indicate the source of an Emergency Care Attendance.

name: ATTENDANCE_SOURCE_ORGANISATION
text: ATTENDANCE_SOURCE_ORGANISATION: Attendance Source Organisation. ORGANISATION SITE IDENTIFIER (EMERGENCY CARE ATTENDANCE SOURCE) is the ORGANISATION IDENTIFIER of the Organisation Site from which a Patient arrived at an Emergency Care Department.

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1
text:
CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1: Care Professional Tier 1. The tier of care professional treating the patient during an Emergency Care Attendance. The care professional tiers for emergency care are defined in the Royal College of Emergency Medicine Guidelines for Medical and Practitioner Staffing in Emergency Departments (see link).

Each care professional the patient sees is given in each subsequent care_professional_tier_NN field.

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_2
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_2: Care Professional Tier 2. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_3
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_3: Care Professional Tier 3. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_4
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_4: Care Professional Tier 4. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_5
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_5: Care Professional Tier 5. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_6
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_6: Care Professional Tier 6. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_7
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_7: Care Professional Tier 7. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_8
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_8: Care Professional Tier 8. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_9
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_9: Care Professional Tier 9. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_10
text: CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_10: Care Professional Tier 10. This is a repeating field. See CARE_PROFESSIONAL_TIER_1 for details

name: CHIEF_COMPLAINT
text: CHIEF_COMPLAINT: Chief Complaint. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to indicate the nature of the Patient's chief complaint as assessed by the CARE PROFESSIONAL first assessing the Patient.

name: CHIEF_COMPLAINT_EXTENDED_CODE
text: CHIEF_COMPLAINT_EXTENDED_CODE: Chief Complaint Extended Code. EMERGENCY CARE CHIEF COMPLAINT (Extended) is the Lorenzo concept ID which is used to indicate the nature of the Patient's chief complaint as assessed by the CARE PROFESSIONAL first assessing the Patient. This will only appear where code is different from EMERGENCY CARE CHIEF COMPLAINT (SNOMED CT) Group: ATTENDANCE OCCURRENCE ACTIVITY CHARACTERISTICS

name: COMMISSIONER
text: COMMISSIONER: Commissioner. The Organisation Code of the Organisation commissioning health care as issued by the Organisation Data Service (ODS) and validated against reference data. The value is the Commissioner Code reason for access to data held on user smart cards and is used for item 'Reason Access Provided'. This value is submitted by the provider organisation and is subject to change on a given record as data is updated at source and resubmitted.

name: COMMISSIONER_REFERENCE_NUMBER
text: COMMISSIONER_REFERENCE_NUMBER: Commissioner Reference Number. This is locally defined between the provider and the Commissioner. it is a free text alphanumeric field for use within a Commissioning Data Set.

name: COMMISSIONING_SERIAL_NUMBER
text: COMMISSIONING_SERIAL_NUMBER: Commissioning Serial Number. A code agreed between the provider and the commissioner that indicates the commissioning contract line or other local commissioning granularity to aid commissioning discussion. If it begins with an "=" sign, this indicates that the record is excluded from the national tariff and a local agreement for the activity is in place, this activity will not be given a PbR price.

name: COMORBIDITIES_1
text: COMORBIDITIES_1: Comorbidities 1. A record of whether a person has any of the NHS list of medical co-morbidities. Each comorbidities is listed separately in one the repeated fields Comorbidities_NN

name: COMORBIDITIES_2
text: COMORBIDITIES_2: Comorbidities 2. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_3
text: COMORBIDITIES_3: Comorbidities 3. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_4
text: COMORBIDITIES_4: Comorbidities 4. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_5
text: COMORBIDITIES_5: Comorbidities 5. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_6
text: COMORBIDITIES_6: Comorbidities 6. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_7
text: COMORBIDITIES_7: Comorbidities 7. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_8
text: COMORBIDITIES_8: Comorbidities 8. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_9
text: COMORBIDITIES_9: Comorbidities 9. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_10
text: COMORBIDITIES_10: Comorbidities 10. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_1
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_1: Comorbidities Valid Approved 1. Tests whether corresponding Comorbidity Code is approved on the activity_date

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_2
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_2: Comorbidities Valid Approved 2. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_3
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_3: Comorbidities Valid Approved 3. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_4
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_4: Comorbidities Valid Approved 4. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_5
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_5: Comorbidities Valid Approved 5. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_6
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_6: Comorbidities Valid Approved 6. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_7
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_7: Comorbidities Valid Approved 7. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_8
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_8: Comorbidities Valid Approved 8. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_9
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_9: Comorbidities Valid Approved 9. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_10
text: COMORBIDITIES_VALID_APPROVED_10: Comorbidities Valid Approved 10. This is a repeating field, see Comorbidities Valid Approved 1

name: CONCLUSION_DATE
text: CONCLUSION_DATE: Conclusion Date. An Accident and Emergency Attendance Conclusion Date is the date that a Patient's Accident and Emergency Attendance concludes or when treatment in the Accident and Emergency Department is completed, whichever is the later For those PatientS admitted into hospital, the ACCIDENT AND EMERGENCY ATTENDANCE CONCLUSION DATE is recorded as the date when the DECISION TO ADMIT was made.

name: CONCLUSION_TIME
text: CONCLUSION_TIME: Conclusion Time. The time (HH:MM:SS) at which the attendance was concluded.

name: CONVEYING_AMBULANCE_TRUST
text: CONVEYING_AMBULANCE_TRUST: Conveying Ambulance Trust. The organisation code of the conveying ambulance trust, if specified.

name: DECIDED_TO_ADMIT_DATE
text: DECIDED_TO_ADMIT_DATE: Decided To Admit Date. DECIDED TO ADMIT DATE is the same as attribute DECIDED TO ADMIT DATE. DECIDED TO ADMIT DATE may be the same as the date of admission (e.g. most emergency admissions). Alternatively, a decision can be made to admit at a future date. This decision denotes that the Patient is intended to be admitted to a Hospital Bed, either immediately or subsequently in the future. It records the event that a clinical DECISION TO ADMIT a Patient to a Hospital Bed has been made by or on behalf of someone, who has the right of admission to a Hospital Provider.

name: DECIDED_TO_ADMIT_TIME
text: DECIDED_TO_ADMIT_TIME: Decided To Admit Time. The time a decision to admit was made.

name: DEPARTMENT_TYPE
text: DEPARTMENT_TYPE: Department Type. The department type in which the Patient was treated

name: DEPARTURE_DATE
text: DEPARTURE_DATE: Departure Date. An Accident and Emergency Departure Date is the date that a Patient leaves an Accident and Emergency Department after an Accident and Emergency Attendance has concluded.

name: DEPARTURE_TIME
text: DEPARTURE_TIME: Departure Time. The time (HH:MM:SS) at which the patient departed A&E.

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1: Diagnosis Code 1. Recorded A&E diagnosis in SNOMED CT format. Multiple diagnoses are listed out separately in the repeating field DIAGNOSIS_CODE_NN

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_2
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_2: Diagnosis Code 2. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_3
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_3: Diagnosis Code 3. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_4
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_4: Diagnosis Code 4. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_5
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_5: Diagnosis Code 5. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_6
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_6: Diagnosis Code 6. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_7
text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_7: Diagnosis Code 7. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

text: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_8: Diagnosis Code 8. This is a repeated field, see DIAGNOSIS_CODE_1

name: DIAGNOSIS_CODE_9

text: LPI_ORGANISATION_CODE: LPI Organisation Code. The organisation code of the organisation that assigned the Local Patient Identifier.

text: OVERSEAS_VISITOR_CHARGING_CATEGORY: Overseas Visitor Charging Category. The charging category relating to an overseas visitor at the time of the activity.

name: PERIOD_END_DATE
text: PERIOD_END_DATE: Period End Date. This should indicate the end date of a referral to treatment clock calculation; it may be when the first definite treatment started or when another relevant stopping event occurred.

name: PERIOD_START_DATE
text: PERIOD_START_DATE: Period Start Date. This is that date of one of a variety of events that starts the referral to treatment clock calculation, for example the initial referral date or the failed to attend clinic date.

name: PERIOD_STATUS
text: PERIOD_STATUS: Period Status. One of a set of defined codes that indicates this treatment's position within a referral to treatment period or the fact that this treatment is not part of a referral to treatment measured pathway.

name: PLACE_OF_INJURY
text: PLACE_OF_INJURY: Place Of Injury. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to identify the type of LOCATION at which the Patient was present when the injury occurred.

name: PRACTICE_CODE_Patient_REGISTRATION
text: PRACTICE_CODE_Patient_REGISTRATION: Practice Code Patient Registration. The organisation code of the GP Practice that the patient is registered with. The code before testing against reference files. In the event that an organisation code cannot be given, the ODS default codes must be used.

name: PREFERRED_SPOKEN_LANGUAGE
text: PREFERRED_SPOKEN_LANGUAGE: Preferred Spoken Language. SNOMED CT concept ID which is used to capture the preferred spoken LANGUAGE of the PERSON.

name: PRIME_RECIPIENT
text: PRIME_RECIPIENT: Prime Recipient. The mandatory NHS Organisation Code (or valid Organisation Data Service Default Code) representing the Organisation determined to be the Commissioning Data Set Prime Recipient of the Commissioning Data Set Message as indicated in the Commissioning Data Set Addressing Grid.

name: PROVIDER_CODE
text: PROVIDER_CODE: Provider Code. The Organisation Code of the Organisation acting as a Health Care Provider as issued by the Organisation Data Service (ODS). This field represents the organisation receiving payment for the associated activity. The value of this field is unaltered and is exactly as it was received in the CDS interchange.

name: PROVIDER_REFERENCE_NUMBER
text: PROVIDER_REFERENCE_NUMBER: Provider Reference Number. This is locally defined between the provider and the Commissioner. it is a free text field that may contain letters, numbers or other keyboard symbols for use within a Commissioning Data Set.

name: RECEIVING_SITE
text: RECEIVING_SITE: Receiving Site. ORGANISATION SITE IDENTIFIER (DISCHARGE FROM EMERGENCY CARE) is the ORGANISATION IDENTIFIER of the Organisation Site to which a Patient is discharged following an Emergency Care Attendance.

text: TREATMENT_DATE_1: Treatment Date 1. The date at which treatments were performed while the person was under the care of the Emergency Care facility. Each treatment is denoted in a subsequent TREATMENT_DATE_NN field

name: TREATMENT_DATE_2
text: TREATMENT_DATE_2: Treatment Date 2. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_3
text: TREATMENT_DATE_3: Treatment Date 3. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_4
text: TREATMENT_DATE_4: Treatment Date 4. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_5
text: TREATMENT_DATE_5: Treatment Date 5. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_6
text: TREATMENT_DATE_6: Treatment Date 6. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_7
text: TREATMENT_DATE_7: Treatment Date 7. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_8
text: TREATMENT_DATE_8: Treatment Date 8. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_9
text: TREATMENT_DATE_9: Treatment Date 9. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_10
text: TREATMENT_DATE_10: Treatment Date 10. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_11
text: TREATMENT_DATE_11: Treatment Date 11. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_DATE_12
text: TREATMENT_DATE_12: Treatment Date 12. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_DATE_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_FUNCTION_CODE
text: TREATMENT_FUNCTION_CODE: Treatment Function Code. ACTIVITY TREATMENT FUNCTION CODE (DECISION TO ADMIT) is the TREATMENT FUNCTION CODE of the SERVICE to which a Patient is to be admitted.

name: TREATMENT_TIME_1
text: TREATMENT_TIME_1: Treatment Time 1. The time at which treatments were performed while the person was under the care of the Emergency Care facility. Each treatment is denoted in a subsequent TREATMENT_TIME_NN field

name: TREATMENT_TIME_2
text: TREATMENT_TIME_2: Treatment Time 2. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_3
text: TREATMENT_TIME_3: Treatment Time 3. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_4
text: TREATMENT_TIME_4: Treatment Time 4. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_5
text: TREATMENT_TIME_5: Treatment Time 5. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_6
text: TREATMENT_TIME_6: Treatment Time 6. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_7
text: TREATMENT_TIME_7: Treatment Time 7. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_8
text: TREATMENT_TIME_8: Treatment Time 8. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_9
text: TREATMENT_TIME_9: Treatment Time 9. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_10
text: TREATMENT_TIME_10: Treatment Time 10. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_11
text: TREATMENT_TIME_11: Treatment Time 11. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: TREATMENT_TIME_12
text: TREATMENT_TIME_12: Treatment Time 12. This is a repeating field. See TREATMENT_TIME_1 for details

name: WAITING_TIME_MEASUREMENT_TYPE
text: WAITING_TIME_MEASUREMENT_TYPE: Waiting Time Measurement Type. The type of waiting time measurement methodology which may be applied during a patient pathway.

name: WITHHELD_IDENTITY_REASON
text: WITHHELD_IDENTITY_REASON: Withheld Identity Reason. This field allows suppliers of Commissioning Data Set records to indicate to recipients of the record (for example, the Commissioner of the activity) that the record has been purposely anonymised for a valid reason.

name: ECDSKEY
text: ECDSKEY: Emergency Care Dataset Key. Primary Key of the ECDS. Identity of organisation submitting to commisiong data set

name: ORGANISATION_CODE_UBRN
text: ORGANISATION_CODE_UBRN: Organisation code unique booking reference number. Organisation code of the organisation which generates the Unique Booking Reference Number (UBRN)

name: INTERCHANGE_SENDER
text: INTERCHANGE_SENDER: INTERCHANGE_SENDER. The assigned EDI Address of the physical Organisation or site responsible for sending Commissioning data.

name: PERSON_ID_DEID
text: PERSON_ID_DEID: PERSON_ID_DEID. This field contains a pseudonomised patient identifier which can be used to link patients across different datasets within the TRE

name: ACTIVAGE
text: ACTIVAGE: Age at Activity Date. The age in years of the patient derived by the sender as at the relevant CDS activity date of the CDS type.

name: ADMINCAT
text: ADMINCAT: Administrative Category Code. This indicates how the activity is funded, eg NHS or Private Patient.

name: APPDATE
text: APPDATE: appdate. The date (with an associated CDS Applicable Time) of the update event (or the nearest equivalent) that resulted in the need to exchange this Commissioning Data Set.

name: APPOINTMENT_TIME
text: APPOINTMENT_TIME: Appointment Time. Submitted field Appointment Time The time, recorded using the 24 hour clock, advised to a PATIENT for when they can expect to see a relevant CARE PROFESSIONAL at an Out-Patient Clinic.

name: APPTAGE
text: APPTAGE: Age on Day of Appointment. age of the patient at the appointment

name: APPTAGE_CALC
text: APPTAGE_CALC: Age on Day of Appointment (Decimalised). The age of the patient on the record start date. The maximum value output is 120. If the patient is older than 1 year, a calculation is made by dividing the number of days from the Date of Birth by 365.25 to determine the age in years, otherwise the age is returned as an age in fraction:

name: APPTDATE
text: APPTDATE: Appointment Date. This is the date the appointment took place or will take place if it is in the future. It is the CDS Originating Date used as the CDS ACTIVITY DATE for Outpatient Appointment CDS Types 020 and 021.

name: ATENTYPE
text: ATENTYPE: Attendance Type. Attendance Type is derived from the fields Attended or Did Not Attend and First Attendance.

name: ATTENDED
text: ATTENDED: Attended or Did Not Attend. An indication of whether an appointment took place or not and if not, whether advance warning was given.

name: ATTENDKEY
text: ATTENDKEY: HES Record Identifier. This is a record identifier that is created by the HES system. The digits store a decimal number. This is commonly eight or nine digits but can be up to 14.

name: BABYAGE
text: BABYAGE: Age of Baby. The age of the patient in days where their age range code is between 7001 and 7003 (inclusive). For OP, the age is calculated on the Appointment Date.

name: CANREG
text: CANREG: Cancer Registry Area of Residence. The former cancer registry that each postcode fell within. Further information on Cancer Network can be found on the NHS Postcode Directory using the following link; http://systems.digital.nhs.uk/data/ods/datadownloads/pcodedata

name: CARERSI
text: CARERSI: Carer Support Indicator. An indication of whether Carer support is available to the patient at their normal residence. This does not include any paid support or support from a voluntary organisation, unless the patient is normally resident in a Care Home and care is provided by a Care Worker.

name: CCG_GP_PRACTICE
text: CCG_GP_PRACTICE: Clinical Commissioning Group of GP Practice. The derived CCG using the GP Practice in the CDS record

name: CCG_RESIDENCE
text: CCG_RESIDENCE: Clinical Commissioning Group of Residence. This derived field contains the code for the Clinical Commissioning Group (CCG) where the patient lived immediately before admission. It is derived from post code (HOMEADD).

name: CCG_RESPONSIBILITY
text: CCG_RESPONSIBILITY: Clinical Commissioning Group of Responsibility. The CCG of Responsibility value.

name: CCG_RESPONSIBILITY_ORIGIN
text: CCG_RESPONSIBILITY_ORIGIN: Origin of CCG_RESPONSIBILITY. The CCG of Responsibility origin value 1 if derived from the GP Practice 2 if derived from the patient postcode 3 if derived from treatment site 4 if derived from provider code else 9

name: CCG_TREATMENT
text: CCG_TREATMENT: Clinical Commissioning Group of Treatment. The derived CCG using the Treatment Site, or failing that, the Provider Code in the CDS record.

name: CCG_TREATMENT_ORIGIN
text: CCG_TREATMENT_ORIGIN: Origin of CCG_TREATMENT. The HES origin code which indicates the origin of the HESCCGFromTreatmentSiteValue

name: CDSEXTDATE
text: CDSEXTDATE: CDS Extract Date. The date (with an associated CDS Extract Time) of the update event (or the nearest equivalent) that resulted in the need to exchange this Commissioning Data Set.

name: CDSVERPROTID
text: CDSVERPROTID: cdsverprotid. A code to identify the Commissioning Data Set Submission Protocol (NET/BULK) associated with the transaction.

name: CR_GP_PRACTICE
text: CR_GP_PRACTICE: Commissioning Region of GP Practice. The derived Commissioning Region of the GP Practice in the CDS record

name: CR_RESIDENCE
text: CR_RESIDENCE: Commissioning Region of Residence. The Commissioning Region (CR) where the patient lives.

name: CR_TREATMENT
text: CR_TREATMENT: Commissioning Region of Treatment. The derived CR code using the Treatment Site in the CDS record.

name: CURRWARD_ONS
text: CURRWARD_ONS: Current Electoral Ward (ONS). the current electoral ward ONS

name: DIAG_3_01
text: DIAG_3_01: Diagnosis Code - 3 Character. Diagnosis code, shortened to 3 characters

name: DIAG_4_01
text: DIAG_4_01: Diagnosis Code - 4 Character. Diagnosis code, shortened to 4 characters

name: DIAG_COUNT
text: DIAG_COUNT: Count of Diagnoses. Count of unique values

name: DIAG_3_CONCAT
text: DIAG_3_CONCAT: Concatenated Diagnosis Codes - 3 Character. Concatenated field showing diagnosis 3 character codes

name: DIAG_4_CONCAT
text: DIAG_4_CONCAT: Concatenated Diagnosis Codes - 4 Character. Concatenated field showing diagnosis 4 character codes

name: DNADATE
text: DNADATE: Last DNA or Patient Cancelled Date. Last DNA or Patient Cancelled Date is derived from Offered for Admission Date and Admission Offer Outcome and is needed to meet central requirements. It is recorded when patients who have been offered a date for admission have missed this admission date with or without advance notice.

name: DOB_IND
text: DOB_IND: Date of Birth Indicator. An indicator of the DB validity: '0' - DOB is valid '1' - DOB is missing '2' - DOB is present but invalid

name: EARLDATOFF
text: EARLDATOFF: Earliest Reasonable Date Offered. Earliest Reasonable Offer Date is the date of the earliest of the Reasonable Offers made to a Patient for an Appointment or Elective Admission.

name: ETHNOS
text: ETHNOS: Ethnic Category. A code that indicates the ethnicity of the patient

name: ETHRAWL
text: ETHRAWL: Ethnic Category (Local Code). A character that indicates the ethnicity (audit version) of the patient

name: FIRSTATT
text: FIRSTATT: First Attendance. Indicates if an attendance is the first in a series. This is an essential item for correct allocation of a Healthcare Resource Group.

name: GORTREAT
text: GORTREAT: Government Office Region of Treatment. The derived GOR code using the Provider Code in the CDS record.

name: GPPRAC
text: GPPRAC: GP Practice Code. The organisation code of the GP Practice that the patient is registered with. The code before testing against reference files. In the event that an organisation code cannot be given, the ODS default codes must be used.

name: HES_SUSRECID
text: HES_SUSRECID: HES SUS Record Identifier. A generated unique identifier for the record.

name: IMD04
text: IMD04: IMD Index of Multiple Deprivation. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04C
text: IMD04C: IMD Crime Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04ED
text: IMD04ED: IMD Education Training and Skills Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04EM
text: IMD04EM: IMD Employment Deprivation Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04HD
text: IMD04HD: IMD Health and Disability Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04HS
text: IMD04HS: IMD Barriers to Housing and Services Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04I
text: IMD04I: IMD Income Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04IA
text: IMD04IA: IMD Income Affecting Adults Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04IC
text: IMD04IC: IMD Income Affecting Children Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04LE
text: IMD04LE: IMD Living Environment Domain. The score is a domain specific value representing the deprivation level for a given domain

name: IMD04RK
text: IMD04RK: IMD Overall Rank. The Rank is the position in the list of all LSOAs for the given domain of deprivation ordered from most deprived (lowest) to least deprived (highest)

name: LOCCLASS
text: LOCCLASS: Location Class. Location Class is a high-level classification for use within Commissioning Data Set messages of the physical location within which the recorded patient event occurs.

name: LOPATORG
text: LOPATORG: lopatorg. The organisation code of the organisation that assigned the Local Patient Identifier.

name: LSOA01
text: LSOA01: Lower Super Output Area of Residence 2001. Look up Lower Layer Super Output Area code based on patient postcode for 2001 - 2010

name: LSOA11
text: LSOA11: Lower Super Output Area of Residence 2011. Look up Lower Layer Super Output Area code based on patient postcode for 2011 - 2020

name: MAINSPEF
text: MAINSPEF: Main Specialty. This item is the specialty in which the consultant is contracted or recognised and the code identifies a specialty as designated by Royal Colleges.

name: MSOA01
text: MSOA01: Middle Super Output Area of Residence 2001. Look up Middle Layer Super Output Area code based on patient postcode for 2001 - 2010

name: MSOA11
text: MSOA11: Middle Super Output Area of Residence 2011. Look up Middle Layer Super Output Area code based on patient postcode for 2011 - 2020

name: NEWNHSNO_CHECK
text: NEWNHSNO_CHECK: NHS Number Check Flag. Indicates whether the format of the NHS number supplied in the field NEWNHSNO is valid or not. The NHS number is 10 numeric digits in length. The tenth digit is a check digit used to confirm its validity. The check digit is validated using the modulus 11 algorithm.

name: NHSNOIND
text: NHSNOIND: NHS Number Status Indicator. This is a flag that indicates if the NHS Number of the patient has been traced by the sender against the tracing service e.g.

name: NODIAGS
text: NODIAGS: Number of Diagnoses. Report field Number of diagnoses

name: NOPROCS
text: NOPROCS: Number of Procedures. Report field Number of Procedures

name: OPERSTAT
text: OPERSTAT: Operation Status Code. Indicates whether an operative procedure was carried out or if a procedure was not intended for this activity. Values can be:

name: OPERTN_3_01
text: OPERTN_3_01: Procedure Code - 3 Character. Procedure code, shortened to 3 characters

name: OPERTN_4_01
text: OPERTN_4_01: Procedure Code - 4 Character. Procedure code, shortened to 4 characters

name: OPERTN_4_CONCAT
text: OPERTN_4_CONCAT: Concatenated Procedure Codes - 4 Character. Concatenated field showing procedure 4 character codes

name: ORGPPPID
text: ORGPPPID: Organisation Code (Patient Pathway Identifier Issuer). This is the code of the organisation that assigned the Patient Pathway Identifier. Patient Pathway Identifiers are not necessarily unique across hospitals, the addition of the organisation code ensures uniqueness.

name: OUTCOME
text: OUTCOME: Outcome of Attendance. Records the action resulting from the attendance such as making another appointment or ending the series of consultations by discharging the patient. It does not record clinical outcome.

name: PCFOUND
text: PCFOUND: Postcode Found Flag. This is a flag to indicate if the postcode is valid.

name: PCON_ONS
text: PCON_ONS: Westminster Parliamentary Constituency of Residence (ONS). Look up Westminster Parliamentary Constituency Pre 2011 ONS code based on patient postcode

name: PCTNHS
text: PCTNHS: Organisation Code (Residence Responsibility). Organisation Code (Residence Responsibility) is the Organisation Code derived from the patient's postcode of usual address, where they reside  within the boundary of a:

name: PCTORIG_HIS
text: PCTORIG_HIS: Origin of PCTCODE_HIS. HES style origin: '1', '2', '4', '5', or '6'. This indicates which information was used to return a PCT code in HESPCTResponsibleValue

name: POSTDIST
text: POSTDIST: Postcode District. The outward code of the patient's home postcode (first 2, 3, or 4 characters before the space)

name: PRIMERECP
text: PRIMERECP: CDS Prime Recipient Identity. The mandatory NHS Organisation Code (or valid Organisation Data Service Default Code) representing the Organisation determined to be the Commissioning Data Set Prime Recipient of the Commissioning Data Set Message as indicated in the Commissioning Data Set Addressing Grid.

name: PRIORITY
text: PRIORITY: Priority Type. The priority of a request for services: in the case of services to be provided by a consultant, it is as assessed by or on behalf of the consultant. The permitted values are:

name: PROCODE
text: PROCODE: Provider Code. The code of the organisation acting as the health care provider. This field can contain a mixture of organisation codes and site codes (some providers submit all their records to their main organisation code, others use individual site codes).

name: PROCODE3
text: PROCODE3: Provider Organisation Code. Derives the first 3 characters of a provider code

name: PROCODE5
text: PROCODE5: Provider Code (5 character). Derives the first 5 characters of a provider code

name: PROCODET
text: PROCODET: Provider Code of Treatment. Derives truncated provider code of a provider code Args: record (CDSRecord):  The record for which to derive the truncated provider code

name: PROTYPE
text: PROTYPE: Provider Type. The derived provider type using the Provider Code in the CDS record.

name: PURCODE
text: PURCODE: Commissioner Code. The Organisation Code of the Organisation commissioning health care as issued by the Organisation Data Service (ODS) and validated against reference data. The value is the Commissioner Code reason for access to data held on user smart cards and is used for item 'Reason Access Provided'. This value is submitted by the provider organisation and is subject to change on a given record as data is updated at source and resubmitted.

name: PURVAL
text: PURVAL: Commissioner Code Status. Indicates if the diagnosis is a notifiable disease

name: RECORD_IS_VALID
text: RECORD_IS_VALID: Record is Valid. A flag that denotes whether a record is valid or not

name: REFERORG
text: REFERORG: Referring Organisation Code. Referring Organisation Code is the Organisation Code of the Organisation from which the referral is made, such as a GP Practice, NHS Trust or NHS Foundation Trust.

name: REFSOURC
text: REFSOURC: Source of Referral. Shows how the series of consultations within an outpatient episode originated e.g. following an Accident and Emergency attendance by the patient's General Practitioner or other health professional, self-referral.

name: REQDATE
text: REQDATE: Referral Request Received Date. The date the Referral request was received by the Health Care Provider.

name: RESCTY_ONS
text: RESCTY_ONS: County of Residence (ONS). Look up Country Code Pre 2011 ONS code based on patient postcode

name: RESGOR_ONS
text: RESGOR_ONS: Government Office Region of Residence (ONS). Look up Government Office Region Pre 2011 ONS code based on patient postcode

name: RESLADST_ONS
text: RESLADST_ONS: Local Authority District of Residence (ONS). Derived code for the Local Authority District of Residence.

name: RESPCT06
text: RESPCT06: Primary Care Trust of Residence 2006. Derived code for the primary care trust of residence 2006.

name: RTTPEREND
text: RTTPEREND: Referral to Treatment Period End Date. This should indicate the end date of a referral to treatment clock calculation; it may be when the first definite treatment started or when another relevant stopping event occurred.

name: RTTPERSTART
text: RTTPERSTART: Referral to Treatment Period Start Date. This is that date of one of a variety of events that starts the referral to treatment clock calculation, for example the initial referral date or the failed to attend clinic date.

name: RTTPERSTAT
text: RTTPERSTAT: Referral to Treatment Period Status. One of a set of defined codes that indicates this treatment's position within a referral to treatment period or the fact that this treatment is not part of a referral to treatment measured pathway.

name: RURURB_IND
text: RURURB_IND: Rural / Urban Indicator. Look up Rural Urban code for the home address of the patient

name: SENDER
text: SENDER: CDS Sender Identity. The assigned EDI Address of the physical Organisation or site responsible for sending Commissioning data.

name: SERVTYPE
text: SERVTYPE: Service Type Requested. The terms of reference for the Referral Request.

name: SEX
text: SEX: Current Gender of Patient. The current gender of the patient. The codes to be submitted are as follows:

name: SITETRET
text: SITETRET: Site Code of Treatment. Site Code of Treatment is the Organisation Code of the location where the patient was treated, i.e. it should enable the treating Organisation site to be identified. Different sites at the same provider organisation will share the same first three characters. Where activity is carried out by another provider organisation through a sub-contract or other agreement the site code belonging to this other provider should be present to show the actual location where treatment was delivered.

name: STAFFTYP
text: STAFFTYP: Medical Staff Type. Indicates if the patient was seen by the lead care professional or a member of the professional team.

name: SUBDATE
text: SUBDATE: Submission Date. The date the interchange was received by SUS+

name: SUSHRG
text: SUSHRG: Healthcare Resource Group - SUS Generated. The core HRG derived by SUS - as a result of HRG grouping - and used for tariff application.

name: SUSHRGVERS
text: SUSHRGVERS: Healthcare Resource Group Version Number - SUS Generated. The version of episode HRG calculated by SUS.

name: SUSSPELLID
text: SUSSPELLID: SUS Generated Spell Identifier. The generated unique identifier for the episode.

name: TRETSPEF
text: TRETSPEF: Treatment Specialty. Treatment Function Code is based on Main Specialty but also includes approved sub-specialties and treatment specialties that denote further specialisation.

name: WAIT_IND
text: WAIT_IND: Waiting Calculation Indicator. Indicates the validity of the appointment wait duration.

name: WAITDAYS
text: WAITDAYS: Duration of Wait (Referral to Treatment Period). The total time of the subject referral to treatment period calculated by subtracting the Referral To Treatment Period Start Date from the Referral To Treatment Period End Date (in whole days). Both fields are submitted data.

name: WAITING
text: WAITING: Days Waiting. This is the duration from the requested or cancellation date to the appointment date.

name: WITHHELD_IDENTITY_REASON
text: WITHHELD_IDENTITY_REASON: Witheld Identity Reason. This field allows suppliers of Commissioning Data Set records to indicate to recipients of the record (for example, the Commissioner of the activity) that the record has been purposely anonymised for a valid reason. Values can be:

name: NICOR Cardiac Audits
text: NICOR Cardiac Audits. NICOR. Dataset available in NHS England SDE (no HDR Gateway entry). Keywords: nicor

name: 2_39_HISTORY_OF_POOR_MOBILITY
text: 2_39_HISTORY_OF_POOR_MOBILITY: History of poor mobility. Severe impairment of mobility secondary to musculoskeletal or neurological dysfunction.

name: 3_96_SURGICAL_INCISION
text: 3_96_SURGICAL_INCISION: Surgical incision. Identifies incision used for access to the heart.

name: 5_01_UNIT_COLLECTIVE_RESPONSIBILITY_CASE
text: 5_01_UNIT_COLLECTIVE_RESPONSIBILITY_CASE: Unit Collective Responsibility Case. Complex or very high risk case in which an appropriately constituted MDT has pre-determined, and documented pre-operatively, that the Unit should take responsibility for the outcome of the case (rather than an individual surgeon).

name: 6_01_DISCUSSED_AT_DOCUMENTED_QUORATE_PREOP_MDT
text: 6_01_DISCUSSED_AT_DOCUMENTED_QUORATE_PREOP_MDT: Discussed at documented quorate preop MDT. Discussed at documented quorate preop MDT

name: 6_02_HAEMOGLOBIN_AT_TIME_OF_SURGERY
text: 6_02_HAEMOGLOBIN_AT_TIME_OF_SURGERY: Haemoglobin at time of Surgery. Haemoglobin at time of Surgery

name: 6_03_BLOOD_PRODUCT_TRANSFUSION_INTRA_AND_OR_POST_OP
text: 6_03_BLOOD_PRODUCT_TRANSFUSION_INTRA_AND_OR_POST_OP: Blood product transfusion (intra and/or post op). Identifies whether the patient has received any blood product (FBC, FFP, Platelets) transfusion intra or postoperatively (from the time of induction of anaesthesia until discharged from hospital).

name: 6_04_RED_BLOOD_CELL_RBC_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP
text: 6_04_RED_BLOOD_CELL_RBC_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP: Red blood cell (RBC) transfusion (total units) - intra and post op. Total number of units of RBC transfused from time of induction of anaesthesia until patient leaves hospital.  (i.e. includes both intra and post op transfusion)

name: 6_05_FRESH_FROZEN_PLASMA_FFP_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP
text: 6_05_FRESH_FROZEN_PLASMA_FFP_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP: Fresh frozen plasma (FFP) transfusion (total units) - intra and post op. Total number of units of FFP transfused from time of induction of anaesthesia until patient leaves hospital.  (i.e. includes both intra and post op transfusion)

name: 6_06_PLATELET_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP
text: 6_06_PLATELET_TRANSFUSION_TOTAL_UNITS_INTRA_AND_POST_OP: Platelet transfusion (total units) - intra and post op. Total number of units of Platelets transfused from time of induction of anaesthesia until patient leaves hospital.  (i.e. includes both intra and post op transfusion)

name: ACTUAL_CREATININE_AT_SURGERY
text: ACTUAL_CREATININE_AT_SURGERY: Actual creatinine at time of Surgery. This is the actual creatine closest to the time of surgery.

name: ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY
text: ADMINISTRATIVE_CATEGORY: Administrative Category. The Administrative Category of the patient

name: ADMISSION_DATE
text: ADMISSION_DATE: Admission Date. The date on which the patient was admitted to the hospital where surgery performed.

name: AETIOLOGY
text: AETIOLOGY: Aetiology. Aetiology characterisation.

name: ANGINA_STATUS_PRE_SURGERY
text: ANGINA_STATUS_PRE_SURGERY: Angina status pre-surgery. An indication of the worst angina status within 2 weeks of procedure using the classification system defined by the Canadian Cardiovascular Society (CCS).

name: AORTIC_PATH_ABDOMINAL_SEG1
text: AORTIC_PATH_ABDOMINAL_SEG1: Aortic pathology - Abdomninal Segment Code 5. Identifies the reason for the procedure on the aortic root. Defined as Crurae of diaphragm to aortic bifurcation.

name: AORTIC_PATH_ARCH_SEG1
text: AORTIC_PATH_ARCH_SEG1: Aortic pathology - Arch Segment Code 3. Identifies the reason for the procedure on the aortic root. Defined as Brachiocephalic artery to left subclavian artery.

name: AORTIC_PATH_ASCENDING_SEG1
text: AORTIC_PATH_ASCENDING_SEG1: Aortic pathology - Ascending Segment Code 2. Identifies the reason for the procedure on the ascending aorta. Defined as Sino tubular junction to brachiocephalic artery.

name: AORTIC_PATH_DESC_AORTA_SEG1
text: AORTIC_PATH_DESC_AORTA_SEG1: Aortic pathology - Descending Aorta Segment Code 4. Identifies the reason for the procedure on the aortic arch. Defined as Left subclavian artery to crura of diaphragm.

name: AORTIC_PATH_ROOT_SEG1
text: AORTIC_PATH_ROOT_SEG1: Aortic pathology - Root Segment Code 1. Identifies the reason for the procedure on the aortic root (aortic valve to Sinuses of Valsalva).

text:

Segment Code 3. Identifies the procedure performed on the aortic arch.

name: AORTIC_PROC_ASCENDING_SEG2
text:
AORTIC_PROC_ASCENDING_SEG2: Aortic procedure - Ascending

Segment Code 2. Identifies the procedure performed on the ascending aorta.

name: AORTIC_PROC_DESC_AORTA_SEG2
text:
AORTIC_PROC_DESC_AORTA_SEG2: Aortic procedure - Descending Aorta 

Segment Code 4. Identifies the procedure performed on the descending aorta.

name: AORTIC_PROC_ROOT_SEG2
text:
AORTIC_PROC_ROOT_SEG2: Aortic procedure - Root

Segment Code 1. Identifies the procedure performed on the aortic root.

name: AORTIC_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH
text: AORTIC_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH: Aortic valve haemodynamic pathology. Identifies the haemodynamic pathology of the aortic valve.

name: AORTIC_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE
text: AORTIC_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE: Aortic valve implant type. Identifies the type of valve being used for the replacement.

name: AORTIC_VALVE_OR_RING_SIZE_MM
text: AORTIC_VALVE_OR_RING_SIZE_MM: Aortic valve or ring size (mm). The size in millimetres of the replacement aortic valve or ring.

name: AORTIC_VALVE_PROCEDURE
text: AORTIC_VALVE_PROCEDURE: Aortic valve procedure. Identifies the type of procedure performed on the aortic valve.

name: AORTIC_VALVE_TYPE
text: AORTIC_VALVE_TYPE: Aortic valve type. Identifies the type of valve prior to the procedure.

name: CABG
text: CABG: CABG. Choose if CABG is performed either as a isolated procedure or as part of any other procedure.

name: CARDIOGENIC_SHOCK_PRE_OP
text: CARDIOGENIC_SHOCK_PRE_OP: Cardiogenic shock (Pre-Operation). Identifies whether or not the patient was in shock prior to the operation.

name: CARDIOPLEGIA_INFUSION_MODE
text: CARDIOPLEGIA_INFUSION_MODE: Cardioplegia - Infusion mode. Cardioplegia (intentional and temporary cessation of cardiac activity) - Infusion mode.

name: CARDIOPLEGIA_SOLUTION
text: CARDIOPLEGIA_SOLUTION: Cardioplegia - Solution. Cardioplegia (intentional and temporary cessation of cardiac activity) - Solution

name: CARDIOPLEGIA_TEMPERATURE
text: CARDIOPLEGIA_TEMPERATURE: Cardioplegia - Temperature. Cardioplegia (intentional and temporary cessation of cardiac activity) -Temperature

name: CARDIOPLEGIA_TIMING
text: CARDIOPLEGIA_TIMING: Cardioplegia - Timing. Cardioplegia (intentional and temporary cessation of cardiac activity) - Timing

name: CARDIOPULMONARY_BYPASS
text: CARDIOPULMONARY_BYPASS: Cardiopulmonary bypass. Identifies if full or partial extracorporeal cardiopulmonary support was used for part or all of the procedure.

name: CATEGORY_OF_AVS
text: CATEGORY_OF_AVS: Category of aortic valve stenosis. Category of aortic valve stenosis.

name: CCG_OF_REGISTRATION
text: CCG_OF_REGISTRATION: Clinical Commissioning Group covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format.. Clinical Commissioning Group covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format.

name: CCG_OF_RESIDENCE
text: CCG_OF_RESIDENCE: Clinical Commissioning Group covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format.. Clinical Commissioning Group covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format.

name: CIGARETTE_SMOKING_HISTORY
text: CIGARETTE_SMOKING_HISTORY: Cigarette smoking history. Identifies if the patient smokes cigarettes.  Use of other tobacco products is not to be recorded.

name: CUMULATIVE_BYPASS_TIME
text: CUMULATIVE_BYPASS_TIME: Cumulative bypass time. Cumulative bypass time in minutes irrespective of the number of times on bypass.

name: CUMULATIVE_CROSS_CLAMP_TIME
text: CUMULATIVE_CROSS_CLAMP_TIME: Cumulative cross clamp time. The cumulative cross clamp time in minutes.

name: DATE_AND_TIME_OF_OPERATION
text: DATE_AND_TIME_OF_OPERATION: Date and time of operation. The date and time of the start of the operation.

name: DATE_DISCHARGE_OR_HOSP_DEATH
text: DATE_DISCHARGE_OR_HOSP_DEATH: Date of discharge / Date of death in hospital. The date of discharge from hospital or date or death in hospital.

name: DATE_OF_LAST_CARDIAC_OPERATION
text: DATE_OF_LAST_CARDIAC_OPERATION: Date of last cardiac operation. The date of the most recent operation on the heart or aorta where the pericardium has been opened.

name: DATE_OF_LAST_CATHETERISATION
text: DATE_OF_LAST_CATHETERISATION: Date of last catheterisation. The date of the most recent catheterisation, if any.  Since date of admission is known and date of catheterisation is known it can be calculated if the patient was catheterised during the current admission or not.

name: DIABETES_MANAGEMENT
text: DIABETES_MANAGEMENT: Diabetes management. This is not fully compatible with BCIS but SCTS will retain this set of definitions.  Identifies the type of management, if any, for diabetes. If the patient is on multi-therapy then the most serious option is chosen ie Insulin vs Oral Therapy.

name: DISCHARGE_DESTINATION_CARDIO
text: DISCHARGE_DESTINATION_CARDIO: Discharge destination from cardiothoracic ward. Identifies where the patient went at the end of the episode of care.

name: DSWI
text: DSWI: Deep Sternal wound infection. Deep Sternal wound infection.

name: DSWI_TREATMENT
text: DSWI_TREATMENT: Deep Sternal wound infection treatment. Deep Sternal wound infection treatment.

name: DYSPNOEA_STATUS_PRE_SURGERY
text: DYSPNOEA_STATUS_PRE_SURGERY: Dyspnoea status pre-surgery. An indication of the worst dyspnoea status within 2 weeks of procedure using the classification system defined by the New York Heart Association (NYHA).

name: EJECTION_FRACTION_CATEGORY
text: EJECTION_FRACTION_CATEGORY: Ejection fraction category. Categorises the percentage of the blood emptied from the left ventricle at the end of the contraction.

name: EXTENT_OF_CORONARY_VESSEL_DIS
text: EXTENT_OF_CORONARY_VESSEL_DIS: Extent of coronary vessel disease. The number of major (left anterior descending, left circumflex and right coronary arteries) vessels with greater than 50% narrowing in any angiographic view.

name: EXTRACARDIAC_ARTERIOPATHY
text: EXTRACARDIAC_ARTERIOPATHY: Extracardiac arteriopathy. Indicates if the patient has a history of peripheral vascular disease.

name: FIRST_ASSISTANT_CALMAN_YEAR_OF_TRAINEE
text: FIRST_ASSISTANT_CALMAN_YEAR_OF_TRAINEE: First assistant - Calman year of trainee. If the Second Operator is a UK registered trainee, their career grade year (1-6).

name: FIRST_ASSISTANT_GRADE
text: FIRST_ASSISTANT_GRADE: First assistant grade. Identifies the grade of the second operator, if any.

name: FIRST_OPERATOR_CALMAN_YEAR_OF_TRAINEE
text: FIRST_OPERATOR_CALMAN_YEAR_OF_TRAINEE: First operator - Calman year of trainee. If the first operator is a UK registered trainee, their career grade year (1-6).

name: FIRST_OPERATOR_GRADE
text: FIRST_OPERATOR_GRADE: First operator grade. Identifies the grade of the sole or principal operator.

name: GP_PRACTICE_CODE_TRACED
text: GP_PRACTICE_CODE_TRACED: The GP Practice that the patient is registered at. ODS code format.. The GP Practice that the patient is registered at. ODS code format.

name: GRAFT_ANASTOMOSIS
text: GRAFT_ANASTOMOSIS: Graft Anastomosis. Graft Anastomosis.

name: GRAFT_CONDUIT
text: GRAFT_CONDUIT: Graft Conduit. Graft Conduit.

name: GRAFT_SITE
text: GRAFT_SITE: Graft Site. The site of the added graft.

name: HEIGHT
text: HEIGHT: Height. The height of the patient in centimetres on the day of the operation.

name: HISTORY_OF_HYPERTENSION
text: HISTORY_OF_HYPERTENSION: History of hypertension. Identifies if the patient has hypertension.

name: HISTORY_OF_NEUROLOGICAL_DIS
text: HISTORY_OF_NEUROLOGICAL_DIS: History of neurological disease. Indicates if the patient has a history of neurological disease.

name: HISTORY_OF_NEUROLOGICAL_DYSFN
text: HISTORY_OF_NEUROLOGICAL_DYSFN: History of neurological dysfunction. Indicates if the patient has a history of neurological dysfunction.

name: HISTORY_OF_PULMONARY_DISEASE
text: HISTORY_OF_PULMONARY_DISEASE: History of pulmonary disease. Indicates if the patient has a history of pulmonary disease.

name: HOSPITAL_IDENTIFIER
text: HOSPITAL_IDENTIFIER: Hospital Identifier. The identifier allocated to the hospital by NICOR.

name: IABP_USED1
text: IABP_USED1: Intra-aortic balloon pump used. An indication of when an intra-aortic balloon pump was used.

name: IABP_USED2
text: IABP_USED2: Intra-aortic balloon pump used. An indication of when an intra-aortic balloon pump was used.

name: IABP_USED3
text: IABP_USED3: Intra-aortic balloon pump used. An indication of when an intra-aortic balloon pump was used.

name: ICS_OF_REGISTRATION
text: ICS_OF_REGISTRATION: ICS covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format. This will be null until at least April 2022 when ICS organisations are rolled out.. Integrated Care System covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format.

name: ICS_OF_RESIDENCE
text: ICS_OF_RESIDENCE: ICS covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format. This will be null until at least April 2022 when ICS organisations are rolled out.. Integrated Care System covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format.

name: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED1
text: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED1: Impeller device used. An indication of when an impellerdevice was used.

name: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED2
text: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED2: Impeller device used. An indication of when an impellerdevice was used.

name: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED3
text: IMPELLER_DEVICE_USED3: Impeller device used. An indication of when an impellerdevice was used.

name: INTERVAL_SURGERY_AND_LAST_MI
text: INTERVAL_SURGERY_AND_LAST_MI: Interval between surgery and last MI. An indicator of the interval between the start of the operation and the most recent myocardial infarction.

name: IV_INOTROPES_PRIOR_TO_ANAESTH
text: IV_INOTROPES_PRIOR_TO_ANAESTH: Intravenous inotropes prior to anaesthesia. Indicates if any inotropic agents, excluding renal dose dopamine, were commenced prior to the induction of anaesthesia.

name: IV_NITRATES_OR_ANY_HEPARIN
text: IV_NITRATES_OR_ANY_HEPARIN: Intravenous nitrates or any heparin. Indicates if either intravenous nitrates or heparin, unfractionated or low molecular weight, were administered prior to the operation for treatment of unstable angina rather than DVT prophlaxis.

name: LA_OF_REGISTRATION
text: LA_OF_REGISTRATION: Local Authority covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format.. Local Authority covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls. ODS code format.

name: LA_OF_RESIDENCE
text: LA_OF_RESIDENCE: Local Authority covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format.. Local Authority covering the area in which the patient’s postcode falls. ODS code format.

name: LEFT_HEART_CATHETERISATION
text: LEFT_HEART_CATHETERISATION: Left heart catheterisation. Indicates if the patient has been catheterised recently.

name: LEFT_MAIN_STEM_DISEASE
text: LEFT_MAIN_STEM_DISEASE: Left main stem disease. Identifies the extent of left main stem disease in any angiographic view.

name: LEFT_VENTRICULAR_FUNCTION
text: LEFT_VENTRICULAR_FUNCTION: Left Ventricular Function. The percentage of the blood emptied from the ventricle at the end of the contraction.

name: LSOA_OF_REGISTRATION
text: LSOA_OF_REGISTRATION: Lower Super Output Area (lowest level without being disclosive) covering the area in which the patient’s GP Practice falls.. ODS code format.. name: MAJOR_AORTIC
text: MAJOR_AORTIC: Major aortic. Choose Major aortic if a procedure as defined in the aortic dataset is chosen.

name: MITRAL_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH
text: MITRAL_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH: Mitral valve haemodynamic pathology. Identifies the haemodynamic pathology of the mitral valve. If the valve is inspected and repair or replacement is not performed then the pathology should best reflect the indication for the inspection.

name: MITRAL_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE
text: MITRAL_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE: Mitral valve implant type. Identifies the type of mitral ring or valve being used for the repair or replacement.

name: MITRAL_VALVE_PROCEDURE
text: MITRAL_VALVE_PROCEDURE: Mitral valve procedure. Identifies the type of procedure, if any, performed on the mitral valve.

name: MITRAL_VALVE_SIZE
text: MITRAL_VALVE_SIZE: Mitral valve size. The size in millimetres of the replacement mitral valve.

name: MITRAL_VALVE_TYPE
text: MITRAL_VALVE_TYPE: Mitral valve type. Identifies the type of valve before the procedure.

text: Month_year_of_birth: Pseudonymised date showing the month and year of birth of the patient. Pseudonymised date showing the month and year of birth of the patient

name: NEW_POST_OP_NEUROLOGICAL_DYSF

name: NON_CARDIOPLEG_MYOCARD_PROTECT

name: NUMBER_AORTA_SEGMENTS_OPERATED

name: NUMBER_OF_PREVIOUS_HEART_OPS
text: NUMBER_OF_PREVIOUS_HEART_OPS: Number of previous heart operations. The number of previous operations as defined in Section 2.07.

name: NUMBER_OF_PREVIOUS_MIS
text: NUMBER_OF_PREVIOUS_MIS: Number of Previous MIs. The number of definite myocardial infarctions prior to surgery.

name: OPERATIVE_URGENCY
text: OPERATIVE_URGENCY: Operative urgency. The level of urgencey, in relation to the operation.

name: OTHER_ACTUAL_CARDIAC_PROCS
text: OTHER_ACTUAL_CARDIAC_PROCS: Other Actual Cardiac Procedures. Identifies which other cardiac procedures (do not fall into CABG, Valve or Major Aortic data).

name: OTHER_CARDIAC_PROCS
text: OTHER_CARDIAC_PROCS: Other Cardiac Procedures. Choose Other Cardiac Procedure if any of the procedures listed in 3.12 are performed either in isolation or as part of another procdure.

name: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED1
text: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED1: Other Support device used. An indication of when Other Support device was used.

name: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED2
text: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED2: Other Support device used. An indication of when Other Support device was used.

name: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED3
text: OTHER_SUPPORT_DEVICE_USED3: Other Support device used. An indication of when Other Support device was used.

name: PA_SYSTOLIC
text: PA_SYSTOLIC: PA systolic. Systolic pulmonary artery pressure in mm Hg recorded from echocardiographic, catheterisation data or Swan-Ganz catheter.

name: PATIENT_STATUS_AT_DISCHARGE
text: PATIENT_STATUS_AT_DISCHARGE: Patient Status at discharge. This must be forced and thus chosen before destination option can be chosen.

name: PERSON_ID_DEID

name: PRE_OPERATIVE_HEART_RHYTHM

name: PREDOMINANT_MYOCARDIAL_PROTECT
text: PREDOMINANT_MYOCARDIAL_PROTECT: Predominant method of myocardial protection. Predominant method of myocardial protection.

name: PRESENTATION
text: PRESENTATION: Presentation. Presentation characterisation.

name: PREVIOUS_CARDIAC_SURGERY
text: PREVIOUS_CARDIAC_SURGERY: Previous cardiac surgery. This has caused confusion as many of the operations listed do not equate to a Previous Cardiac Operation.

name: PREVIOUS_PCI
text: PREVIOUS_PCI: Previous PCI. The purpose of code values 3 and 2 is to distinguish between patients who suffer a relapse after discharge and those who are never well enough to be discharged.

name: PULMONARY_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH
text: PULMONARY_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH: Pulmonary valve haemodynamic pathology. Identifies the haemodynamic pathology of the pulmonary valve.

name: PULMONARY_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE
text: PULMONARY_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE: Pulmonary valve implant type. Identifies the type of pulmonary valve being inserted.

name: PULMONARY_VALVE_PROCEDURE
text: PULMONARY_VALVE_PROCEDURE: Pulmonary valve procedure. Identifies the type of procedure, if any, performed on the pulmonary valve.

name: PULMONARY_VALVE_SIZE
text: PULMONARY_VALVE_SIZE: Pulmonary valve size. The size in millimetres of the replacement pulmonary valve.

name: PULMONARY_VALVE_TYPE
text: PULMONARY_VALVE_TYPE: Pulmonary valve type. Identifies the type of valve before the procedure.

name: REASON_FOR_OTHER_SUPPORT_DEV2
text: REASON_FOR_OTHER_SUPPORT_DEV2: Reason for use of Other Support device. An indicator of the reason for inserting Other Support device.

name: REASON_FOR_OTHER_SUPPORT_DEV3
text: REASON_FOR_OTHER_SUPPORT_DEV3: Reason for use of Other Support device. An indicator of the reason for inserting Other Support device.

name: REASON_FOR_VAD3

text: RENAL_FUNCTION_DIALYSIS: Renal function/Dialysis. Renal function/Dialysis.

text: REPEAT_AORTIC_VALVE_OP: Reason for repeat aortic valve  operation. Identifies the reason a previous aortic valve procedure pefromed during a previous surgical intervention is being revised/repeated.

name: REPEAT_MITRAL_VALVE_OP
text: REPEAT_MITRAL_VALVE_OP: Reason for repeat mitral valve operation. Identifies the reason a previous mitral valve procedure pefromed during a previous surgical intervention is being revised/repeated.

name: REPEAT_PULMONARY_VALVE_OP
text: REPEAT_PULMONARY_VALVE_OP: Reason for repeat pulmonary valve operation. Identifies the reason a previous pulmonary valve procedure pefromed during a previous surgical intervention is being revised/repeated.

name: REPEAT_TRICUSPID_VALVE_OP
text: REPEAT_TRICUSPID_VALVE_OP: Reason for repeat tricuspid valve operation. Identifies the reason a previous tricuspid valve procedure pefromed during a previous surgical intervention is being revised/repeated.

name: RETURN_TO_THEATRE
text: RETURN_TO_THEATRE: Return to Theatre. Identifies the reason for a re-operation.

name: SEVERITY_OF_AVS_EOA_IN_CM2
text: SEVERITY_OF_AVS_EOA_IN_CM2: Severity of Aortic Valve Stenosis. The mean gradient in mm Hg and /or EOA across the aortic valve.ates the severity based upon values entered in 2.24.1 & 2.24.2 the value that indicates the more severe degree of valvular stenosis should be used. Required for calculation of one or more risk scores.

name: SEVERITY_OF_AVS_GRADIENT_MMHG
text: SEVERITY_OF_AVS_GRADIENT_MMHG: Severity of Aortic Valve Stenosis. Severity of Aortic Valve Stenosis (Gradient mmHg).

name: SEX
text: SEX: Sex. A classification of the sex of a PERSON. One of the fields used to identify the patient in the absence of NHS Number.

name: TOTAL_CIRCULATORY_ARREST_TIME
text: TOTAL_CIRCULATORY_ARREST_TIME: Total circulatory arrest time. Total circulatory arrest time in minutes.

name: TOTAL_DISTAL_CORONARY_ANASTAM
text: TOTAL_DISTAL_CORONARY_ANASTAM: Total number of distal coronary anastamoses. The total number of distal coronary anastamoses performed.

name: TRICUSPID_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH
text: TRICUSPID_VALVE_HAEMODYN_PATH: Tricuspid valve haemodynamic pathology. Identifies the haemodynamic pathology of the tricuspid valve.

name: TRICUSPID_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE
text: TRICUSPID_VALVE_IMPLANT_TYPE: Tricuspid valve implant type. Identifies the type of tricuspid ring or valve being used for the repair of replacement.

name: TRICUSPID_VALVE_PROCEDURE
text: TRICUSPID_VALVE_PROCEDURE: Tricuspid valve procedure. Identifies the type of procedure, if any, performed on the tricuspid valve.

name: TRICUSPID_VALVE_TYPE
text: TRICUSPID_VALVE_TYPE: Tricuspid valve type. Identifies the type of valve before the procedure.

name: VAD_USED3

name: VENTILATED_PRE_OPERATION
text: VENTILATED_PRE_OPERATION: Ventilated (Pre-Operation). Indicates whether or not the patient was ventilated prior to arrival in the operating theatre suite. EuroSCORE Critical Pre-operative state.

name: VERSION_FILE_SUBMITTED_IN
text: VERSION_FILE_SUBMITTED_IN: The version of the file that the hospital submitted the record on. The version of the file that the hospital submitted the record on.

name: WEIGHT
text: WEIGHT: Weight. The weight of the patient in kilograms on the day of the operation.

name: 1_03_NHS_NUMBER_DEID
text: 1_03_NHS_NUMBER_DEID: 1_03_NHS Number De-Identified. A pseudonymised unique national identifier for patient.

name: NHS_NUMBER_DEID
text: NHS_NUMBER_DEID: NHS Number De-Identified. A pseudonymised unique national identifier for patient.

name: 1_07_GENDER
text: 1_07_GENDER: Gender. Identifies the genotypical sex of the patient.

name: 1_08_ETHNIC_GROUP
text: 1_08_ETHNIC_GROUP: Ethnic group. Identifies the patient's ethnic origin. Ethnicity values use the standard NHS list for ethnicity.

name: 1_09_PATIENT_ADMIN_STATUS
text: 1_09_PATIENT_ADMIN_STATUS: Admission status. Type of admission, i.e., from UK public health service or other mode of entry to the service. 'Amenity Patient' is one who pays for the use of a single room or small ward in accordance with the National Health Service Act 2006. Some NHS patients are treated at private hospitals because of capacity issues: these should be coded as NHS patients.

name: 2_01_DIAGNOSIS1
text: 2_01_DIAGNOSIS1: Diagnosis. 2.01 The pre-procedural diagnosis of the patient. Primary diagnosis should reflect the main intended therapeutic procedure regardless of whether procedure carried out successfully or failed.

name: 2_02_PREVIOUS_PROCEDURE
text: 2_02_PREVIOUS_PROCEDURE: Previous procedure. 2.02 Relevant previous procedures; Relevant previous operations or interventions should be coded here, as of April 2015. AEPC (EPCC) diagnostic coding should be used and has been in use since 1st April 2003, with rejection of other codes in force since 1st April 2004. For data export purposes multiple values should be separated using semicolons.

name: 2_03_WEIGHT
text: 2_03_WEIGHT: Patient weight. 2.03 The patients weight in kg at the time of procedure to two decimal places.

name: 2_03B_HEIGHT
text: 2_03B_HEIGHT: Patient height. 2.03a Height or length in cm at the time of the procedure.

name: 2_04_ANTENATAL_DIAGNOSIS

text: 2_08_PRE_PROCEDURE_SYSTEMIC_VENTRICULAR_EJECTION_FRACTION: Systemic ventricular ejection. 2.08 Categorises the percentage of the blood emptied from the systemic ventricle at the end of the contraction. Data may have been derived from angiography, echocardiography, nuclear imaging, magnetic resonance imaging etc. Use this metric to define ventricular function in patients with functionally single ventricle anatomy.

name: 2_09_PRE_PROCEDURE_SUB_PULMONARY_VENTRICULAR_EJECTION_FRACTION
text: 2_09_PRE_PROCEDURE_SUB_PULMONARY_VENTRICULAR_EJECTION_FRACTION: Subpulmonary ventricle ejection. 2.09 Categorises the percentage of the blood emptied from the subpulmonary ventricle at the end of the contraction. Data may have been derived from angiography, echocardiography, nuclear imaging, magnetic resonance imaging etc. Do not use this metric for patients with functionally single ventricle anatomy or pathway of treatment, i.e. when the subpulmonary LV or RV is significantly hypoplastic, the "Not applicable" category should be entered. It is acknowledged that this can be a marginal decision, such as with double outlet RV.

name: 3_01_DATE_OF_VISIT

name: 3_01B_PROCEDURE_URGENCY

name: 3_01C_UNPLANNED_REOPERATION
text: 3_01C_UNPLANNED_REOPERATION: unplanned re-operation. 3.01c Used to identify cases that aren't part of the planned pathway for that patient: 1. Yes; 2. No. Select‚ 'Yes' if fits the definition: Unplanned re-operations are procedures outside the expected patient pathway which may be undertaken at any time from the start of the postoperative admission up until 30 days following the primary operation. Unplanned re-operations may be cardiac bypass, cardiac non-bypass, pacemaker placement (lead revision/repositioning), interventional catheterisations or diaphragm plication (as per NHSE inclusion in SSQD). Unplanned re-intervention cannot be elective by definition. Select‚'No' if fits one of the following:Not a re-intervention within 30-days (if there is no other countable procedures within 30-days prior to unplanned procedure).Staged intervention, for example septostomy followed by arterial switch (neither of which are elective); Planned re-intervention (patient admitted for catheter intervention with subsequent planned surgery stenting of pulmonary artery followed by Fontan needs to be documented). These should both be elective. Additional procedures or revisions undertaken within the primary trip to the operating theatre (incorporating return onto cardiopulmonary bypass) are not included in the definition of re-operation. (However, patients that have, for example, a failed catheter device implantation followed by an urgent device removal (surgical) should be entered as 2 procedures and the second should be an unplanned re-operation).The definition does not include procedures for bleeding, closure of chest, support(ECLS/ECMO) or other non-cardiac surgery procedures or other non-bypass cardiac procedures that would be classified in the 'Minor and Excluded Procedures' procedure type these are not counted as unplanned re-operation irrespective of the urgency.

text: 3_07_TYPE_OF_PROCEDURE: Type of procedure. 3.07 Defines the group the procedure should be included in.

name: 3_10_TOTAL_BYPASS_TIME
text: 3_10_TOTAL_BYPASS_TIME: Total bypass time. 3.10 The total duration of cardiopulmonary bypass used during the procedure. Cumulative total of bypass duration, in minutes, for the whole operation. If there is a period of circulatory arrest this should be included in the total bypass time as well as recorded in the cross clamp time. If there is a period of selective antegrade cerebral perfusion (SACP) it should also be included in the total bypass time. For example, where bypass starts at 10pm ends at 10.30pm, cerebral perfusion starts at 10.30pm ends at 11.00pm, then bypass restarts at 11pm and ends at 11.30pm, 90 minutes of bypass should be recorded.

name: 3_11_TOTAL_BYPASS_CROSS_CLAMP_TIME
text: 3_11_TOTAL_BYPASS_CROSS_CLAMP_TIME: Total bypass cross_clamp time. 3.11 The total duration of aortic cross clamp during the procedure. Cumulative total of cross clamp duration, in minutes, for the whole operation.

name: 3_12_TOTAL_CIRCULATORY_ARREST_TIME
text: 3_12_TOTAL_CIRCULATORY_ARREST_TIME: Total circulatory arrest time. 3.12 The total duration of circulatory arrest during the procedure.  Cumulative total of total circulatory arrest, in minutes, for the whole operation. Selective cerebral perfusion should not be considered as part of the circulatory arrest time.

name: 3_13_CATHETER_PROCEDURE_DURATION
text: 3_13_CATHETER_PROCEDURE_DURATION: Catheter duration. 3.13 The operative time taken.  Defined as first needle to skin to final catheter withdrawal, in minutes. This does not include the time taken for induction of anaesthesia, or local pressure for haemostasis after catheter withdrawn. If the patient is on ECLS then the catheter time out isn't relevant; use the time out of theatre.

name: 3_14_TOTAL_FLUOROSCOPY_TIME

name: 4_07_DURATION_POST_OP_INTUBATION
text: 4_07_DURATION_POST_OP_INTUBATION: post-operation intubation duration. 4.07 Duration of postoperative intubation associated with a procedure. Total, cumulative number of days of postoperative endotracheal intubation. A day is defined as any period between 00:01 and 24:00, even if that is just a matter of minutes. It is possible, therefore to have a value of 2 days for this field despite being ventilated for a matter of minutes (the purpose of this field is to identify long term postoperative ventilation). Day 1 is the day of operation, as is the case for PICANet. It includes any days of invasive ventilation during the PICU stay associated with the procedure. For non-tracheostomy patients this does not include non-invasive CPAP or optiflow. For patients with a permanent tracheostomy only count the days when the patient is having respiratory support, mechanical ventilation or CPAP.
