name: 14_00_HEART_FAILURE
text: 14_00_HEART_FAILURE: Confirmed diagnosis of heart failure. 14 The diagnosis of heart failure

name: 15_00_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FU
text: 15_00_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FU: Was a referral to the hospital heart failure nurse follow-up made?. 15.0 Referred for follow-up with a heart failure specialist nurse - this could be at a hospital. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a heart failure nurse service following discharge.

name: 15_01_CARDIAC_REHAB
text: 15_01_CARDIAC_REHAB: Was a referral to cardiac rehabilitation made?. 15.01 Referred to a cardiac rehabilitation programme. Cardiac rehabilitation usually involves an exercise-based programme that includes educational and psychological support, but can occur without an exercise component if the patient cannot tolerate exercise. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a cardiac rehabilitation programme following discharge.

name: 15_03_CARDIOTHORACIC_SURGERY
text: 15_03_CARDIOTHORACIC_SURGERY: Was a referral for cardiothoracic surgery made?. 15.03 Referred for cardiothoracic surgery at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred for cardiothoracic surgery following discharge.

name: 15_04_TRANSPLANT
text: 15_04_TRANSPLANT: Was a referral for transplant made?. 15.04 Referred for a heart transplant at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred for a heart transplant following discharge.

name: 15_05_PALLIATIVE_CARE
text: 15_05_PALLIATIVE_CARE: Was a referral to palliative care services made?. 15.05 Referred to specialist palliative care services at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to specialist palliative care services following discharge.

name: 15_07_CARDIOLOGY_FU
text: 15_07_CARDIOLOGY_FU: Was a referral to cardiology follow-up made?. 15.07 Referred to follow-up with or involving a cardiologist. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to cardiology follow-up following discharge.

name: 15_12_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT_WITH_THE_HF_MDT
text: 15_12_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT_WITH_THE_HF_MDT: Was a review appointment with the specialist multidisciplinary HF team made?. 15.12 Review appointment with a member of the heart failure multi-disciplinary team, following discharge.

name: 15_13_DATE_OF_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT
text: 15_13_DATE_OF_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT: Date of review appointment. 15.13 If a review appointment has been arranged, the date of the appointment.

name: 15_14_STABLE_ON_ORAL_THERAPY_AFTER_DISCHARGE_PLANNING
text: 15_14_STABLE_ON_ORAL_THERAPY_AFTER_DISCHARGE_PLANNING: Was the patient stable on oral therapy after discharge planning?. 15.14 Stability on oral therapy prior to discharge. Stability means that a patient's prescription levels have not been changed, and that their weight and renal function are stable, for 48 hours prior to discharge.

text: 2_00_DATE_OF_VISIT: Date of admission. 2 Date of admission to hospital.

text: 3_01_BREATHLESSNESS: Breathlessness. 3.01 This is a standard breathlessness score used to assign New York Heart Association Classification on admission.

text: 3_04_PERIPHERAL_OEDEMA: Peripheral oedema. 3.04 Ankle or sacral oedema on admission

text: 4_00_PREVIOUS_IHD: IHD. 4 History of myocardial infarction (MI), angina, ECG evidence of MI, CABG or angiogram documenting coronary artery disease.

text: 4_07_PREVIOUS_DEVICE_THERAPY: Device therapy (prior to or during this admission). 4.07 Device therapy either during this admission or at a previous time.

name: 4_08_PREVIOUS_DEVICE_MODE

name: 4_09_PREVIOUS_VALVE_DISEASE
text: 4_09_PREVIOUS_VALVE_DISEASE: Valve disease. 4.09 History of clinically diagnosed valve disease, moderate or severe stenosis or regurgitation on imaging, or an operative valve replacement/repair

name: 4_10_PREVIOUS_CONGENITAL_HEART_DISEASE
text: 4_10_PREVIOUS_CONGENITAL_HEART_DISEASE: Congenital heart disease. 4.1 A defect of the heart or great vessels that has been present since birth.

name: 4_12_PREVIOUS_HYPERTENSION
text: 4_12_PREVIOUS_HYPERTENSION: Hypertension. 4.12 Recorded  BP >140/90 on at least two occasions prior to admission, or already receiving treatment (drug, dietary or lifestyle) for hypertension

name: 4_14_PREVIOUS_DIABETES

name: 14_01_HEART_FAILURE_DIAGNOSIS

name: 15_00_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_THE_HOSPITAL_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FOLLOW_UP_MADE
text: 15_00_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_THE_HOSPITAL_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FOLLOW_UP_MADE: Was a referral to the hospital heart failure nurse follow-up made?. Referred for follow-up with a heart failure specialist nurse - this could be at a hospital. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a heart failure nurse service following discharge.

name: 15_01_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_CARDIAC_REHABILITATION_MADE
text: 15_01_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_CARDIAC_REHABILITATION_MADE: Was a referral to cardiac rehabilitation made?. Referred to a cardiac rehabilitation programme. Cardiac rehabilitation usually involves an exercise-based programme that includes educational and psychological support, but can occur without an exercise component if the patient cannot tolerate exercise. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a cardiac rehabilitation programme following discharge.

name: 15_03_WAS_A_REFERRAL_FOR_CARDIOTHORACIC_SURGERY_MADE
text: 15_03_WAS_A_REFERRAL_FOR_CARDIOTHORACIC_SURGERY_MADE: Was a referral for cardiothoracic surgery made?. Referred for cardiothoracic surgery at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred for cardiothoracic surgery following discharge.

name: 15_04_WAS_A_REFERRAL_FOR_TRANSPLANT_MADE
text: 15_04_WAS_A_REFERRAL_FOR_TRANSPLANT_MADE: Was a referral for transplant made?. Referred for a heart transplant at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred for a heart transplant following discharge.

name: 15_05_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_PALLIATIVE_CARE_SERVICES_MADE
text: 15_05_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_PALLIATIVE_CARE_SERVICES_MADE: Was a referral to palliative care services made?. Referred to specialist palliative care services at discharge. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to specialist palliative care services following discharge.

name: 15_07_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_CARDIOLOGY_FOLLOW_UP_MADE
text: 15_07_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_CARDIOLOGY_FOLLOW_UP_MADE: Was a referral to cardiology follow-up made?. Referred to follow-up with or involving a cardiologist. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to cardiology follow-up following discharge.

name: 15_08_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_THE_COMMUNITY_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FOLLOW_UP_MADE
text: 15_08_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_THE_COMMUNITY_HEART_FAILURE_NURSE_FOLLOW_UP_MADE: Was a referral to the community heart failure nurse follow-up made?. Referred for follow-up with a community heart failure specialist nurse - this could be at a hospital. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a community heart failure nurse service following discharge.

name: 15_09_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_HF_CARDIOLOGIST_FOLLOW_UP_MADE
text: 15_09_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_HF_CARDIOLOGIST_FOLLOW_UP_MADE: Was a referral to HF cardiologist follow-up made?. Referred to follow-up with or involving a heart failure cardiologist. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a heart failure cardiologist follow-up following discharge.

name: 15_12_WAS_A_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT_WITH_THE_SPECIALIST_MULTIDISCIPLINARY_HF_TEAM_MADE
text: 15_12_WAS_A_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT_WITH_THE_SPECIALIST_MULTIDISCIPLINARY_HF_TEAM_MADE: Was a review appointment with the specialist multidisciplinary HF team made?. Review appointment with a member of the heart failure multi-disciplinary team, following discharge.

name: 15_13_DATE_OF_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT
text: 15_13_DATE_OF_REVIEW_APPOINTMENT: Date of review appointment. If a review appointment has been arranged, the date of the appointment.

name: 15_14_WAS_THE_PATIENT_STABLE_ON_ORAL_THERAPY_AFTER_DISCHARGE_PLANNING
text: 15_14_WAS_THE_PATIENT_STABLE_ON_ORAL_THERAPY_AFTER_DISCHARGE_PLANNING: Was the patient stable on oral therapy after discharge planning?. Stability on oral therapy prior to discharge. Stability means that a patient's prescription levels have not been changed, and that their weight and renal function are stable, for 48 hours prior to discharge.

name: 15_16_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_HF_SPECIALIST_PHARMACIST_FOLLOW_UP_MADE
text: 15_16_WAS_A_REFERRAL_TO_HF_SPECIALIST_PHARMACIST_FOLLOW_UP_MADE: Was a referral to HF specialist pharmacist follow-up made?. Referred to follow-up with or involving a HF specialist pharmacist. This should record referral at the point of discharge, so 'Yes' should be selected if the patient will be referred to a HF specialist pharmacist follow-up following discharge.

name: 15_17_IS_A_HEART_FAILURE_PRE_DISCHARGE_MANAGEMENT_PLAN_IN_PLACE
text: 15_17_IS_A_HEART_FAILURE_PRE_DISCHARGE_MANAGEMENT_PLAN_IN_PLACE: Is a heart failure pre-discharge management plan in place?. The personalised pre-discharge management plan that is drawn up for the patient prior to discharge. Ideally this should be discussed with the patient and their carers, and should include advice about lifestyle, medicines, weight management, monitoring signs and symptoms, disease prognosis and palliative care if appropriate. A discharge plan should be communicated to the primary care team, including discussion of up-titration and continuation of medicines and ongoing care outside of hospital. The discharge plan should take into account patient and carer wishes, and the level of care and support that can be provided in the community.
